subject: How to customise fonts used in .Rmd and .Rnw files deployed to shinyapps.io

messages.author: d70cd3716ddaec25
messages.subject: How to customise fonts used in .Rmd and .Rnw files deployed to shinyapps.io
parts:
My organization has an in-house style that requires Open Sans font for all our reports. However, this doesn't seem to be on offer on the engine used to generate reports on our Shiny apps deployed to shinyapps.io (using downloadHandler) - I get an error message saying that opensans.sty not found. Can this be done, and if so, what are the steps?


In addition, I am finding that shinyapps seem to ignore the 'mystyles.sty' file that I include in the 'in_header' part of the YAML frontmatter, as well as the 'template: template.tex' argument. Why might this be - it works perfectly when I knit the document in RStudio directly on my laptop, but not in the shinyapp once deployed?
